rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for coaching or guidance by a person.

example.english: The coach gave me a lot of coaching to help improve my serve.
example.traditional: 教練畀我好多指導，幫我改善發球。
example.jyutping: gaau3 lin6 bei2 ngo5 hou2 do1 zi2 dou6 bong1 ngo5 goi2 sin6 faat3 kau4

rows.note: Use this when the coaching is framed as teaching or instruction, especially in an educational setting.

example.english: The coaching in this course is very clear.
example.traditional: 呢個課程嘅教學好清晰。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 ge3 gaau3 hok6 hou2 cing1 sik1

rows.note: Use this when coaching develops practical skills, performance, or athletic ability.

example.english: The coach says this month's coaching will focus more on fitness.
example.traditional: 教練話今個月嘅訓練會加強體能。
example.jyutping: gaau3 lin6 waa6 gam1 go3 jyut6 ge3 fan3 lin6 wui5 gaa1 koeng4 tai2 nang4

rows.note: Use this specifically for academic tutoring or extra lessons.

example.english: I go for coaching after school to prepare for the next exam.
example.traditional: 我放學後去補習，準備下次考試。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 hok6 hau6 heoi3 bou2 zaap6 zeon2 bei6 haa6 ci3 haau2 si3
